title: Collect Franka joint state data
goal: Add Franka joint position, velocity, and torque to Release observations, raw collection pickles, and the supported LeRobot conversion without changing control behavior.
doneWhen: Each 30 Hz observation includes 7-D joint position, velocity, and torque arrays from the Franka state.
The fields are retained in collected_data pickle observations and exported into LeRobot-compatible state data with a documented schema.
Focused no-hardware tests validate dimensions and conversion behavior.
decisions: Use measured joint position, velocity, and torque from the existing Franka driver state; do not derive or command joints.
Preserve the existing TCP/gripper state fields and append named joint fields through the standard observation wrapper rather than changing control actions.
The existing LeRobot state vector will gain 21 joint-state values, so downstream consumers must inspect the exported feature schema rather than assume the previous 19-D state width.

verification.summary: Release commit d31a695 records measured 7-D Franka q, dq, and tau_J in every observation and carries the expanded state vector through the existing pickle and LeRobot conversion paths.
checks: Synthetic LeRobot conversion preserved a 40-D state vector
Configuration parse, Python compilation, shell syntax, and Git diff whitespace checks passed
limitations: No hardware collection has run after adding measured joint torque.
New datasets have a 40-D exported state vector; downstream code must not assume the prior 19-D state width.
